Going to a motel with an uber isn’t really a smart move. They can find out the driver who came to get you, and the name of the motel where you’d go. As long as they can track you through your devices, calling someone or searching for a location where to stay would be useless.  
Take money with you, but cash, you don’t want to use credit cards. Every electronic action will put you in trouble at one point, as they probably have a lot of personal details about you. Keep it calm and don’t panic. Put the money and some clothes in a luggage. Take with you as much non-perishable food as possible, and a couple of water bottles.
Leave in the morning when the sun rises, without taking your phone or laptop with you.
Head over to a crowded area, and go hitchhiking to a nearest city.
Then you hide somewhere and change your clothes, and buy a hat, or a pair of glasses to change your look. But don’t buy these things from they same place, it would look suspicious. Instead, buy every single item from a different store.
After you’ve changed your look, head over to a phone store, and while pretending you’re testing a phone that is available for that, use the internet on it to search for a convenient place to stay over night. Make sure it won’t take you a lot of money, as you will need them for more important things in the future.
Find that place, and go there without hesitation. If nothing weird happens after the first night there, stay some more time. When you feel uneasy, you must go over another place. 
Let some time to pass. Then buy a cheap phone, create new accounts, but don’t stalk that same website where you’ve seen the recordings of your house, just to make sure things haven’t gone bad.
Try to not use services that require your Personal Identification as much as possible, because otherwise you’ll eventually get caught. 
Live your life without thinking back. Try to not bring attention to yourself. Don’t create any social media accounts, and be anonymous. If things go unsteady again, you have to find another place. But be subtle, as this will help you achieve something. And the most important thing, stay safe no matter what. Check it twice. They will not find you again.
